raw.harness: Actual production HTML/CSP/bundle/ready; immutable before/after bundle bytes override the same resource route. Other assets and fixture input are common.
raw.scope: Production HTML/CSP/ready with archived baseline and current browser bundles; common HTML/CSS and immutable fixture. 5000 rows, 4999 edges, 1000 branches, 250 tags. Independent Chromium lifetimes in the explicit recorded order. 16 latency messages at CPU 6x and separate 32-message unthrottled CPU and post-GC JS heap windows after 8 warmups. Within-page samples are correlated. Complete stable Chromium PID counters and separate Node/Playwright CPU; no Native Git, active VS Code timing, total RSS or physical peak claim. Full snapshot equality verified outside measured windows.
